title: Data Explorer Core Check
prompt:
Build the core of a data explorer:

1. `groupBy(records, keyFn)` RETURNS a plain object mapping each key (from `keyFn(record)`) to the array of matching records.
2. `uniqueBy(records, keyFn)` RETURNS the records deduplicated by key, keeping the first occurrence of each.
3. `summarize(records)` RETURNS `{ count, avgScore, top }` — the record count, the mean of the `score` fields, and the whole record with the highest score. Empty input returns `{ count: 0, avgScore: 0, top: null }`.
4. `safeGet(records, index)` RETURNS the record at `index`, or `null` when the index is out of range or not an integer. It must never throw.

tests.name: groupBy groups records by keyFn
tests.hint: Walk the array once; for each key, push into (out[key] ??= []).

tests.name: uniqueBy keeps the first occurrence per key
tests.hint: Track seen keys in a Set; push the record only when the key is new.

tests.name: summarize computes count, average, and top
tests.hint: Guard the empty case first; then loop once accumulating sum and best-so-far.

tests.name: safeGet never throws and returns null for bad indexes
tests.hint: Check Number.isInteger(index) and 0 <= index < records.length before touching the array.
